applies_to: Australian major banks, residual-income valuation on tangible common equity
method_note: Levers are MULTIPLICATIVE FACTORS on each name's own measured ROTCE, never absolute ROE values. That keeps this registration symbol-agnostic and genuinely prior to any valuation: it can be committed without knowing what any name's ROTCE is.

evidence_basis.measure: each year's ROE divided by that name's own 13-year mean ROE
evidence_basis.note: The bear factor is deliberately set at a level the sector has actually reached (WBC FY20 0.308, NAB FY20 0.436, ANZ FY20 0.553, WBC FY21 0.694) rather than at a round number. The assigned 25% bear probability is more pessimistic than the 9.6% empirical frequency; that conservatism is intentional and is not to be revised because a resulting value looks low.

levers.label: bear
levers.rationale: A credit-cycle downturn of the depth the four majors reached in FY20-FY22, short of a NAB-FY16-style write-off year (0.072 of own mean). Empirically 9.6% of name-years were at or below this level; 25% is the deliberately conservative assignment.

levers.label: base
levers.rationale: The name's own measured ROTCE at the point-in-time period, carried as the starting point of the fade. No forecast is applied.

levers.label: bull
levers.rationale: A return toward the 2013-2015 profitability band (ANZ 1.24-1.40, WBC 1.32-1.43, CBA 1.18-1.22 of own mean). Empirically 21.2% of name-years were at or above this level.

probability_note: 25/50/25 matches the prior already hardcoded in asxos/domain/decision_engine/builder.py:492-502, so the two surfaces do not disagree. Probabilities sum to exactly 100.
ke_treatment: Ke is NOT a scenario lever. Ke uncertainty is carried by the stated beta range 0.90-1.20 and the +/-1% sensitivity table. Scenario uncertainty is the ROE path only. Keeping them separate is what stops the two mechanisms double-counting.
pre_commitment: Ruled by James 2026-09-08 and recorded here before any model run: if this method values a name materially below its market price, NO horizon extension, NO growth term and NO terminal excess return will be added to close the gap. A method revision is an ADR decision made on queue-wide evidence, never on one name.
